title: Save the blur value selected when the user taps Done.
comment:
**Save the blur value selected when the user taps Done.**

If the user moves the ruler from 25 to 0 and taps Done before the new preview finishes, `effect` still holds the bitmap for 25. The non-null check accepts it and saves the old blur. Capture the ruler value at submission and render the export from it, or disable Done until the preview is tagged with that same value.

title: Block the discard action while the image is saving.
comment:
**Block the discard action while the image is saving.**

System Back still opens `DiscardChangesDialog` while `SavingLayer` is visible. The overlay blocks touch, but `BackHandler` handles system Back separately. The user can confirm discard after the write has changed the working file but before `onSaved()` runs. Consume Back while `saving` is true without opening the dialog. Keep normal discard behavior when no save is active. ([developer.android.com](https://developer.android.com/guide/navigation/custom-back?utm_source=openai))

title: Do not gate image-save completion on the guide flag.
comment:
**Do not gate image-save completion on the guide flag.**

If `writePng` succeeds but the DataStore edit throws `IOException`, the working file has already changed and `onSaved()` is never called. Handle guide persistence separately from image-save completion. Notify the editor once after the successful write, even if the guide flag cannot be stored. title: Bound the install request as well as the status wait.
comment:
**Bound the install request as well as the status wait.**

The 60-second timeout starts only after `Tasks.await(modules.installModules(request))` returns. If the request Task stalls, the tool stays on its loader and never reaches its error state. Use a cancellable Task wait under the install deadline. Also bound the separate availability and processing waits so either can return a recoverable error. ([developers.google.com](https://developers.google.com/android/reference/com/google/android/gms/tasks/Tasks.html?utm_source=openai))

title: Check that MediaStore publishes the collage before reporting success.
comment:
**Check that MediaStore publishes the collage before reporting success.**

PNG encoding can succeed while the update that clears `IS_PENDING` fails. If the update returns `0`, this code returns the URI as a successful save. If the update throws, the error path leaves the pending row behind. Include publication in the cleanup block, check the affected-row count, and return the URI only after publication succeeds.

title: Bound the bitmap cache by the active collage and rollback state.
comment:
**Bound the bitmap cache by the active collage and rollback state.**

Every replacement or custom background adds a decoded bitmap to `bitmaps`, but abandoned paths never leave it. A two-photo collage can retain about 244 MiB of pixel data after 100 distinct 800×800 replacements, even though it still shows only two photos. Evict paths that are no longer used by the current state or an active rollback snapshot.

title: Wait for the selected background before enabling Save.
comment:
**Wait for the selected background before enabling Save.**

If all cell photos are loaded, the user can apply a custom background and immediately save while that background still decodes. `loaded` checks only cell paths. The captured PNG can then omit the selected background and leave transparent gaps. Include the active background in the readiness check. If it fails to load, let the user retry or choose another background.

title: Preserve the working image if PNG encoding fails.
comment:
**Preserve the working image if PNG encoding fails.**

`outputStream()` truncates `imagePath` before `compress()` succeeds. If storage fills during encoding, Remove BG reports a failed save, but the editor's working image can already be empty or incomplete. Encode to a sibling temporary file and replace the working image only after the encode and close succeed. Delete the temporary file on failure. ([developer.android.com](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/util/AtomicFile.html?authuser=1&utm_source=openai))

title: Replace the working PNG only after encoding succeeds.
comment:
**Replace the working PNG only after encoding succeeds.**

If the user applies Brush and then a filter write runs out of space, `FileOutputStream(file)` has already truncated the brush result. The editor still shows the brush result and leaves `edited` true. A later Save can copy the incomplete file.

Encode into a temporary file in the same directory. Replace the working file only after encoding and closing the stream succeed. Remove the temporary file on failure.

title: Keep the panel open when Apply fails.
comment:
**Keep the panel open when Apply fails.**

If rendering a brush draft fails before it writes a file, `commit` shows a toast and closes the panel. Reopening Brush clears the strokes and undo history, so the user cannot retry without redrawing. Close the panel only after a successful commit. On failure, clear `busy` and leave the draft open. This is separate from preserving the previous working PNG.

title: Handle a failed media scan before reporting Save success.
comment:
**Handle a failed media scan before reporting Save success.**

If the scanner returns a null URI, it did not add the file to the media database. The callback discards that result, so the editor still calls `onSaved` after the repository sync. Check the URI and keep the editor open on failure. Retry publication of the file already written, or remove it before retrying Save, so a retry does not leave a second export behind. ([developer.android.com](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/media/MediaScannerConnection.OnScanCompletedListener?authuser=108&utm_source=openai))

title: Use the preview's text layout for export.
comment:
**Use the preview's text layout for export.**

If a long text sticker wraps on a narrow image, `renderTexts` measures the entire unwrapped line and gives that width to `StaticLayout`. The export centers that wider layout on the bitmap and can cut off text that was visible in the preview. Reuse the preview's line breaks and alignment, or render both paths with the same layout constraints and scale that layout for export. ([developer.android.com](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/text/StaticLayout.Builder?authuser=302792331&utm_source=openai))
